# Sikh Gurbani App (sikhi.vercel.app)

> Free, fast, mobile-first Sikh Gurbani & Nitnem reading platform created by Harpreet Singh (https://singhharpreet.vercel.app). 
> Provides original Gurmukhi script alongside English, Hindi, and Punjabi translations, English/Hindi phonetic transliterations, and Gurbani AI Insights.

## Core Purpose
The platform enables readers worldwide to study, read, and recite Sikh daily prayers (Nitnem) and scripture from the Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji and Dasam Granth in a calm, distraction-free environment.

## Primary Routes & Resources

- [Sikh Gurbani Home & Dashboard](https://sikhi.vercel.app): Personal Nitnem Dashboard with streak counter, resume reading card, and live SGPC Kirtan stream.
- [Sundar Gutka Library](https://sikhi.vercel.app/gutka): Complete scripture library of 113+ Sikh Baanis and daily Nitnem prayers.
- [Reading Insights & Analytics](https://sikhi.vercel.app/insights): Personal reading statistics, consistency scores, habits, and milestone celebrations.
- [Reading History & Progress](https://sikhi.vercel.app/history): Saved reading history and exact verse scroll positions.
- [Japji Sahib](https://sikhi.vercel.app/bani/japji): First prayer composed by Guru Nanak Dev Ji with line-by-line Gurmukhi text and translations.
- [Jaap Sahib](https://sikhi.vercel.app/bani/jaap): Composed by Guru Gobind Singh Ji.
- [Tav-Prasad Savaiye](https://sikhi.vercel.app/bani/svaiye): Morning Nitnem prayer.
- [Chaupai Sahib](https://sikhi.vercel.app/bani/chaupai): Prayer for protection composed by Guru Gobind Singh Ji.
- [Anand Sahib](https://sikhi.vercel.app/bani/anand): Song of bliss composed by Guru Amar Das Ji.
- [Rehras Sahib](https://sikhi.vercel.app/bani/rehras): Evening Nitnem prayer.
- [Sukhmani Sahib](https://sikhi.vercel.app/bani/sukhmani): Psalm of Peace composed by Guru Arjan Dev Ji.
- [Gurbani Search](https://sikhi.vercel.app/search): Real-time search engine for Gurbani verses.

## Key Features for Readers
- **Gurmukhi Unicode**: Accurate modern Gurmukhi script.
- **Ask AI Gurbani Insights**: Deep 7-part AI spiritual explanations (Punjabi, English, History, Philosophy, Key Teaching, References, Daily Life) powered by Gemini AI.
- **Live Gurbani Kirtan**: Official 24/7 SGPC live audio broadcast from Sri Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple, Amritsar).
- **Larivaar Mode**: Toggle continuous scripture text without word breaks.
- **Automatic Position Resume**: Remembers and auto-scrolls to your exact last read verse line across all Baanis.
- **Multilingual Meanings**: English, Hindi, and Punjabi translations.
- **Phonetic Transliteration**: English and Hindi Romanized text for pronunciation.
- **Theme & Display Customization**: Light mode, Dark mode, font scaling, and reading progress indicators.

## Developer & Creator Information
- Created by: Harpreet Singh (https://singhharpreet.vercel.app)
- Data Source: BaniDB Public API (https://api.banidb.com/v2)
- Platform: Next.js 16 (App Router), Vercel AI SDK, Serwist PWA, Vercel
